lines: My heart pounding so loud it drowns everything out
My legs, unlike me, frozen in place right now
The tears sliding quietly down my cheek
They tell me: this is first love
I need you, I need you
I need you, I need you
I need you, I need you
I need you, I need you
Anyone who's human
falls in love as a matter of course
That's what I always believed — but
If I had never met you
I can't believe anyone could ever have
made me feel this way
My heart pounding so loud it drowns everything out
My legs taking off on their own right now
The tears surely sliding down my cheek
They tell me: this is first love
I need you, I need you
I need you, I need you
I need you, I need you
I need you, I need you
For things beyond my control
I kept blaming other people
Pretending I'd accepted them
All along
If I had never met you
I might have just gone on living
Never knowing why I was born
This fragile me, wounded by a single word
I want to give her away, now
The season that will never come again
was about to announce its end
Clumsily
The thing I want
is right there within reach
There is no way I can keep from chasing it
Whether it's right or not, honestly
no one knows
The treetops trembling in the wind
reach toward where the sun shines
We rejoiced over the smallest things
and were wounded by the smallest things
My heart pounding maddeningly
The rain gently striking my shoulders right now
The tears that overflow however I hold them back
They tell me: this is first love
I need you, I need you
I need you, I need you
I need you, I need you
I need you
